title: Structural basis for P-TEFb association with BRD4.
authors: Mohamed, Abdallah A; Vos, Seychelle M
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和AlphaFold建模解析BRD4与P-TEFb复合物结构，聚焦蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，且未涉及TF-DNA互作建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDK) dynamically regulate RNA Polymerase (Pol) II during each stage of transcription. Phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and associated transcription factors by CDKs enables stage-specific exchange of factors. CDK9 and a cyclin partner (CYCT1, T2 or K) comprise the Positive Transcription Elongation Factor-b (P-TEFb) complex, which is responsible for releasing RNA Pol II from promoter proximal pausing into processive elongation. P-TEFb activity is stimulated by bromodomain-containing Protein 4 (BRD4); however, the structural basis for BRD4 association with P-TEFb has remained unclear. Using cryogenic-electron microscopy, AlphaFold modeling, and biochemical probing, we show that the P-TEFb interacting domain of BRD4 (BRD4-PID) interacts with P-TEFb via the C-lobe of CDK9 and the second cyclin domain of CYCT1. The BRD4 binding surface on CDK9 is also used by super elongation complex component AFF4. Our analysis indicates that BRD4 may stimulate P-TEFb activity by remodeling the kinase alphaC helix relative to previous structures. Finally, P-TEFb activity is restricted when bound to the 7SK RNP complex. We show that in addition to BRD4-PID, the AFF4 N-terminus can release P-TEFb from the 7SK RNP complex. Together, these findings define how P-TEFb activity is regulated by its incorporation into distinct complexes. SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT: The exquisite control of gene expression is required for proper development and cellular response to environmental stress. Positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb) is required for the phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and leads to the coordinated release of RNA Pol II from pause sites near the promoter. P-TEFb is bound to bromo-domain containing protein 4 (BRD4), which stimulates P-TEFb activity; however, it is unknown how BRD4 associates with P-TEFb. Here we report a cryo-EM structure of P-TEFb bound to BRD4, revealing how BRD4 interacts with P-TEFb. Comparison of our structure with previously reported P-TEFb structures shows how P-TEFb is regulated by different transcription factor binding partners.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDK）在转录的每个阶段动态调控RNA聚合酶（Pol）II。CDK对RNA Pol II及相关转录因子的磷酸化使得因子能够按阶段特异性进行交换。CDK9与细胞周期蛋白伴侣（CYCT1、T2或K）共同构成正性转录延伸因子b（P-TEFb）复合物，该复合物负责将RNA Pol II从启动子近端暂停释放为持续性延伸。P-TEFb的活性受到含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）的刺激；然而，BRD4与P-TEFb结合的 structural 基础此前尚不清楚。利用冷冻电子显微镜、AlphaFold建模和生化探测，我们表明BRD4的P-TEFb相互作用结构域（BRD4-PID）通过CDK9的C-叶和CYCT1的第二个细胞周期蛋白结构域与P-TEFb相互作用。CDK9上的BRD4结合表面也被超延伸复合物组分AFF4所利用。我们的分析表明，BRD4可能通过重塑激酶alphaC螺旋（相对于先前结构）来刺激P-TEFb活性。最后，当P-TEFb与7SK RNP复合物结合时，其活性受到限制。我们表明，除了BRD4-PID外，AFF4的N-末端也能将P-TEFb从7SK RNP复合物中释放出来。综合这些发现，定义了P-TEFb活性如何通过其整合到不同复合物中而受到调控。意义声明：基因表达的精细调控对于正常发育和细胞对环境应激的响应至关重要。正性转录延伸因子b（P-TEFb）是RNA Pol II磷酸化所必需的，并导致RNA Pol II从启动子附近暂停位点的协调释放。P-TEFb与含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）结合，后者刺激P-TEFb活性；然而，BRD4如何与P-TEFb结合尚不清楚。在此，我们报告了P-TEFb与BRD4结合的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了BRD4如何与P-TEFb相互作用。将我们的结构与先前报道的P-TEFb结构进行比较，展示了P-TEFb如何受不同转录因子结合伙伴的调控。
